title: VIGIA evidence window
description: A frozen, immutable snapshot of live telemetry for one time window. Produced by the Velociraptor adapter (or a replay source), consumed by the deterministic core. The window_hash is the SHA-256 of the canonical serialization of this document with the window_hash field absent.

sequence.description: Monotonic per-case window counter. Gaps are a chain-integrity violation.

source.description: replay = the same window re-fed from disk; must reproduce identical verdict seals.

time_start_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC, inclusive lower bound of the window.

time_end_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC, exclusive upper bound. Events at or after this instant belong to a later window.

collection.description: Provenance of the VQL collection that produced this window.

vql_template_ids.description: Identifiers of pre-committed VQL templates. Raw ad-hoc VQL is forbidden by construction; only curated templates with filled parameter slots may run.

artifacts.description: Normalized forensic artifacts in the shape the core scorer already consumes (ForensicBundle artifact schema).

raw_score.description: Exact fraction num/den. Never a float.

manifest.description: SHA-256 of every raw collected file backing this window, for chain of custody.
